items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Paul Barnes. Oh Lord. Paul told me about one time... [INTERVIEWEE] That's right. Yeah. I hope they did it.

ctx.x: Paul Barnes. Oh Lord. Paul told me about one time they had so many preachers there, so they had to wait till the next day to bury them married and close the cemetery. That's right.
That's right. Yeah. I hope they did it.
